title: Keep the current step connected to the whole
before: The reader knows the goal but can lose their place in a sequence.
after: They know the role of the current change in the whole process.
sequence: Introduce a small overview using familiar roles.
Keep a compact progress map while revealing one change.
Use Wink to direct attention; disclose extra explanation on demand.

source.title: Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors

observation: The lesson explains the mapping from individual arrows to points and collections before using that shorthand.
interpretation: Our overview-and-Wink adaptation keeps a sequence legible while making changes of representation explicit.
example: Keep the request lifecycle visible while Wink points to the handle currently being released.
avoid: An overview crowded with unexplained technical terms.
Leaving the learner to infer the story from motion alone.
check: Can the learner say where they are and why this change matters?

review.interpretation: user-approved design direction; application needs learner review
